known.title: Gate: isolate the production sign-in rate-limit tests

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - running the complete starter API suite.
This login consumes the production server's shared per-IP sign-in quota. The existing test at apps/api/test/api.e2e-spec.ts:215–222 assumes an unused quota and requires its first 30 requests to avoid 429. On fresh runs, the pinned [Vitest sequencer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vitest-dev/vitest/v3.2.4/packages/vitest/src/node/sequencers/BaseSequencer.ts) orders these files by size: auth, invites, then api. When the intervening tests finish within a minute, this earlier login makes the rate-limit test's 30th request return 429, failing the suite despite correct authentication behavior. Reversing their order can instead make this login fail. Isolate the tests' rate-limit state while preserving the production limit.
